confirmed_if: a bound small molecule or fragment with contact set Jaccard >= 0.30 against the 23 residues, by any localising method
declared_in_advance: The 23 residues are final. No re-ranking or re-clustering, whatever any later result shows.
The detector is frozen by hash; a later version does not re-derive this list.
The broken-detector list of 24 residues is recorded (Jaccard 0.880) so neither can be quietly preferred.
The specificity statistic is not a gate: it rejects HRAS's confirmed pocket at the same p = 0.100.

detector.note: LIGSITE, origin snapped to the lattice, averaged over 4 sub-voxel phases

falsified_if: F1 a >=500-fragment screen that samples this surface returns hits elsewhere on beta-catenin and none here at Jaccard 0.30
F2 >=3 further wild-type apo structures are deposited and support falls below 50% under the hashed detector
F3 the surface is an interface for a partner not among the 22 tested, at Jaccard >= 0.30
F4 a structure from a different construct and space group lacks the site under the hashed detector
not_falsification: absence of a published ligand; no one has looked here

prediction.claim: a small molecule can be made to bind a pocket lined by these residues
prediction.location: convex outer face of the armadillo superhelix, not the concave groove

what_this_cannot_establish: Function. Nothing is known to happen on the convex face; a ligand there might do nothing.
Competitive position. 51 clinical studies, nothing approved, every direct agent in the groove.
Construct breadth. Six of eight apo structures are one depositor in C222(1); three space groups, two depositors.
